# CAMPUS HOSTEL ROOM ALLOTMENT POLICY

## 1. OBJECTIVE
This institutional policy defines the room allocation process, security deposits, and verification requirements for campus residential hostels.

## 2. GENERAL ALLOTMENT GUIDELINES
Hostel accommodations are available to eligible students enrolled in full-time degree programs. All residents must abide by code of conduct regulations established by the warden committee.

## 3. APPLICATION WINDOW AND DUE DATE
Students seeking hostel allotment must submit their residential booking requests before 15 July of each academic year. Submissions must include proof of tuition fee clearance.

## 4. DOCUMENTATION AND ALLOTMENT
The enrolled student submits the residential preference form and room deposit receipt. The room key is issued. The hostel supervisor verifies the student identity card against the active enrollment roster.

## 5. LATE APPLICATION DEADLINE
In exceptional circumstances, supplemental room requests may be submitted before 05 August of each academic year with written consent from the hostel warden.

## 6. ADMINISTRATIVE CHECKS AND DUPLICATE VERIFICATION
The hostel supervisor verifies the student identity card against the active enrollment roster. The chief warden evaluates room occupancy rosters and signs the final floor allotment charter.

## 7. PHYSICAL CHECK-IN
The hostel caretaker inspects room inventory with the student and issues the formal possession certificate on check-in day.
